fields.rationale: States cluster around whether they require mutual/reciprocal recognition from the other state in addition to equivalent standards, whether equivalent standards alone suffice, whether a minimum time-under-license or experience threshold is added, whether reciprocity is purely discretionary or tied to a formal agreement, or whether the state defers to a universal portability statute.
